blog_title: ₹85 Plain T-Shirt Quality Check — 5 Things That Make Cheap Tees Look Brand Level for DTF Print
caption:
Lost ₹35,000 on 500 tees because the supplier shipped 140 GSM instead of 180 GSM 😬

No sample ordered. Fabric felt thin on arrival. A medium 180 GSM tee weighs 140-150g — theirs? 100-110g. One kitchen scale caught the fraud.

Here's the test: cut a 1ft square, weigh it, multiply by 10.76. Done.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
